saw_lines: Supplement buyers pick one product, then reorder it for months, and they check the label before they trust the promise.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, before the buyer decides the ad is worth a click.
Your 11 of 18 copy ads open on the same “fai il tuo primo ordine” line, so test three new openers, starting with the protein cake recipe and the calorie calculator.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 3 Nov 2026
points: 11 of 18 copy ads open on “fai il tuo primo ordine”, so a new buyer sees one pitch only. Run three new angles against it: the protein cake recipe, the calorie calculator, and the Dieta Fasica plan walkthrough.

0 of 23 ads are video, so no buyer sees the product move before the click. Shoot three short clips: the protein cake being sliced, a training session with the product, and the calorie calculator on a phone.

One exact copy runs in 9 of 18 ads, so the same buyer sees identical words again. Keep the body text, but rewrite the opening line and swap the creative in each of those 9 ads, one product image per ad.

None of the 23 ads shows a proof number, so a buyer has no count to trust before clicking through. Collect one real number from your records, a review count or orders shipped, and lead the next three ads with it.

ads_1: Protein cake and calorie calculator angles to replace the first order opener
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook and Instagram, your linked channels
